observations.observation: An unquoted HEAD^{tree} revision expression was transformed by PowerShell and made git rev-parse fail.
observations.effect: The tree result supplied no evidence; branch and release probes in the same wrapper were evaluated separately.
observations.correction: A quoted HEAD^{tree} successor returned tree b961221e845545d6933a9550c0a424d3c566adce before the closure commit.

observations.observation: A combined temporary-file anonymous-byte wrapper was rejected by local command policy before execution.
observations.effect: No command, download, file deletion, repository mutation, or evidence result occurred.
observations.correction: Bounded anonymous commit metadata and eight raw files were downloaded separately under C:/Projects/Verification and matched exactly.

observations.observation: The first ls-remote peel check again left refs/tags/v0.0.32^{} unquoted and therefore returned only the tag object before failing its two-line count assertion.
observations.effect: The already published tag was unchanged; the incomplete ref list supplied no peel evidence.
observations.correction: The quoted successor and anonymous GitHub tag APIs verified object ea203784e11afd611666bcd988f4d1e60259f6a8 peeling to f0e565015be2ca8ed155be600a61fe131dbfa012.

observations.observation: Direct PowerShell invocation of the .pyz path with --version produced no program output or child exit code because it did not invoke Python.
observations.effect: The empty invocation supplied no package-runtime evidence.
observations.correction: python <downloaded.pyz> --help exited zero and exposed the exact six-command CLI.

observations.observation: rg was passed scripts/verify_*.py as a Windows path instead of using its native glob option and returned OS error 123.
observations.effect: No validator was read or run by that command.
observations.correction: rg -g verify_*.py resolved the interfaces, and the final coherent validator run passed 40 of 40.

observations.observation: The first validator wrapper guessed nonexistent eval/container-runtime-v12.json after nineteen earlier validators had passed.
observations.effect: The container validator stopped on FileNotFoundError before validating a contract; no product failure occurred.
observations.correction: The exact versioned path eval/container-contract-0032-v12.json passed with implementation and canonical-result requirements.

observations.observation: A successor wrapper omitted PYTHONPATH=src and verify_model_comparison.py stopped at import after five earlier successor validators had passed.
observations.effect: The import failure supplied no model-comparison result.
observations.correction: A single coherent environment-bound rerun passed all 40 phase-correct validators in 3.004 seconds.

observations.observation: An extra wrapper assertion required the literal title Runbook Sentinel in argparse help although the command intentionally prints only usage and subcommands.
observations.effect: The CLI had already exited zero and printed its valid help; the title assertion was not part of the frozen package contract.
observations.correction: The exact usage prefix and run, approve, execute, evaluate, serve, and mcp command set passed.

observations.observation: The first trace-validation wrapper omitted PYTHONPATH=src and stopped at import.
observations.effect: Neither immutable report nor trace was modified or rerun.
observations.correction: The environment-bound successor verified both 261-event traces as valid and anchored.

observations.observation: The first source API summary parser joined the renderer diagnostic with the JSON receipt and ConvertFrom-Json rejected the additional text.
observations.effect: The API run completed, but the mixed console stream supplied no parsed receipt.
observations.correction: A fresh unchanged run bounded the first opening and last closing JSON delimiters and exposed the complete receipt.

observations.observation: A wrapper assumed all 131 check values were Boolean and counted only 130 true Booleans.
observations.effect: The differently typed field was not a failed check.
observations.correction: Inspection found 130 true Booleans plus the exact Content-Security-Policy header value; status was pass and zero check value was false.

observations.observation: The first summary assigned to PowerShell's reserved case-insensitive $false constant.
observations.effect: The already completed native verifier was not changed, but the summary stopped before copying its receipt.
observations.correction: The falseChecks successor confirmed 72 of 72 checks and copied the exact receipt and dashboard into external custody.

observations.observation: The complete-private-key pattern began with hyphens and was passed to rg without an end-of-options marker.
observations.effect: rg parsed the pattern as an option and supplied no scan result.
observations.correction: The option-safe successor ran, and the token-pattern scans returned zero hits.

observations.observation: A literal PEM begin-marker scan matched scanner definitions and historical failure prose.
observations.effect: The literal matches were not credential material and could not pass or fail the release gate.
observations.correction: A bounded complete multiline PEM-body and matching-end-marker scan found zero private-key blocks.

disposition: retained; none of these observations is positive release evidence
